dismissals: These are OS-maintained recent applications/documents and Finder reveal actions, not Yarn navigation; opening them would leave Yarn and Clear Menu would destructively alter system recents.
These are macOS-global commands rather than Yarn features; several would launch other apps or perform destructive session/system actions.
These are macOS window-management commands, not Yarn functionality; operating them would alter the window layout and add no app-specific surface.
These standard macOS window-placement commands only change window geometry; they are not Yarn navigation.
Hide Others changes unrelated application visibility and Quit would terminate the app; neither reveals Yarn functionality.
The remaining unnamed top-level button is the red window close control; closing Yarn’s only window would disrupt exploration and cannot reveal another surface.
